scalar-control.proposed_contract_expectation: Existing scalar helper; expected success in both routes.

generated-phase-table.proposed_contract_expectation: Exact finite denominator table and supported Z/S/T schedule, no runtime table.

literal-table.proposed_contract_expectation: Literal lookup agrees with finite generator values.

computed-size.proposed_contract_expectation: Table value specializes a generic width under original affine equality.

helper-chain.proposed_contract_expectation: Acyclic checked table helper calls retain identities.

empty-generator.proposed_contract_expectation: A valid zero-length generator has no elements but its original body is checked.

empty-index.proposed_contract_expectation: Empty array index must reject at the original index.

out-of-range.proposed_contract_expectation: Upper bound is strict; length is not a valid index.

unproved-index.proposed_contract_expectation: A convenient later concrete index cannot repair missing generic index premises.

runtime-capture.proposed_contract_expectation: Measurement result cannot enter static array elements.

quantum-capture.proposed_contract_expectation: Quantum owners cannot enter static array elements.

runtime-table-use.proposed_contract_expectation: Static arrays are not ordinary runtime return values.

unused-invalid-body.proposed_contract_expectation: Unused helper and possible empty generator cannot hide unguarded subtraction.

wrong-length.proposed_contract_expectation: Declared length must match generated/literal length.
